# Original subtitle test font

OVLFixtureBars.ttf is generated by scripts/generate-font-fixture.py using
fontTools 4.60.2. It contains only empty fallback/space glyphs and an original X
made from two vertical bars. No installed font or third-party glyph was copied.
The unusual geometry distinguishes an embedded font from a system fallback.
The fixture uses the repository license. Tests consume the saved small binary;
fontTools is needed only to regenerate it, not by the server or test runner.

Regenerate with a temporary fontTools installation, then run:

```sh
PYTHONPATH=/path/to/fonttools python3 scripts/generate-font-fixture.py
```

Generator API reference: https://github.com/fonttools/fonttools/blob/4.60.2/Lib/fontTools/fontBuilder.py
